# Reality and Mission

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos renews every page in every instant; therefore Awtsmoos.com must reveal one truthful public Torah page in the first response, not a shell whose meaning exists only after JavaScript awakens.

## Direct evidence

- Current HEAD is `df954de06`.
- SEO route files are clean in Git at the start of this continuation.
- Production Road `/heichelos/ikar/series/BH-likkuteiTorah-שלח/4` resolves server-side far enough to enter the post template.
- Production then leaks a dynamic-template error because `initial-content.html` dereferences `$$sd`, which is not defined in that child template scope.
- The active parent is `heichelos/post/_awtsmoos.post.html`, not the similarly named root shell.
- The parent already receives post/heichel/alias/semantic locals from `postReader.js`.
- The parent currently ignores `postSemanticHead` and hardcodes `Awtsmoos | Torah Revelation`.
- Sibling semantic child templates consume injected locals directly by name.
- `readerData.loadDirect()` still calls the obsolete non-series public post endpoint.

## Mission order

1. Repair the active sibling post template handoff.
2. Repair initial-content local consumption.
3. Surface the already-generated semantic head in the active shell.
4. Normalize direct/root post lookup onto the valid series-scoped API.
5. Prove Road HTML on a fresh server before adding crawl-map breadth.
6. Only then finish robots, sitemap, and sitewide discovery.
